headline: Last session: Sensex drops 319 points, Nifty ends at 25,144 as indices snap winning streak

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on investor market sentiment during the trading session.
Profit-booking emerged at higher levels after early market gains.
Concerns surrounding the global Nvidia crisis influenced tech sentiment.
Selling pressure in select financial stocks dragged down benchmark indices.
whatHappening: On the last trading day, Sensex fell 319 points while Nifty50 closed at 25,144.
Shriram Finance emerged as the top loser among major market indices.
Manappuram Finance shares declined 4% during the session.
Despite Friday's fall, Indian markets extended gains for a third straight week.
summary:
In the last trading session on November 13, Indian benchmark indices snapped their winning streak as the Sensex fell 319 points.
Shriram Finance and Manappuram Finance featured among the prominent losers amid inflation concerns.
Despite the session's pull-back, Indian equity markets recorded gains for the third consecutive week.
